signin.kicker: Members only · ask at the counter
signin.title: What’ll it be?
signin.lead: Use the passkey on this device, or your username and password.
signin.passwordSet: Password saved. Sign in with it.

errors.inviteRequired: That address has not been invited. Pretty Please Print is invite-only — ask whoever owns the printer for a link.
errors.invalidToken: That link is no longer valid. Ask the printer owner for a fresh one.
errors.tokenExpired: That link expired. Ask the printer owner for another.
errors.suspended: That account has been suspended. Ask whoever owns the printer.
errors.other: That sign-in attempt did not go through.

form.refused: That username and password do not match. Try again.
form.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
form.passkeyRefused: That passkey was not accepted. Use your password instead.
form.inviteOnly: Pretty Please Print is invite-only — there is no sign-up. If you have not been invited yet, or you have forgotten your password, ask whoever owns the printer.

nudge.title: Tired of typing your password?
nudge.body: Save a passkey and this device signs you in with a fingerprint — nothing to remember, nothing to phish.
